description: The facts a plain-English rewrite must keep, and the check it is held to.

facts.name: numbers with their punctuation, dates and times as written
facts.text: Ksh 1,250,000 due 2026-10-24 at 15:30, or 10.5% after 3/4 of the term

facts.name: links and emails whole, and the digits inside them not counted twice
a fact repeated is one fact

checks.name: a rewrite that keeps every fact and is shorter passes
checks.original: Pursuant to the agreement dated 2026-10-24, the balance of Ksh 1,250,000 is payable within 30 days.

checks.name: a rounded amount is a missing fact
a reformatted date is a missing fact
a longer rewrite fails even with every fact
checks.rewrite: You need to pay 30 right now, please.
